title: Mall World and Actions that Can’t be Completed?
content: Hi everyone, I’ve experienced dreams set in a gradually evolving underground shopping mall for decades, but didn’t realize it was a thing until I stumbled onto this community a few minutes ago. My mall has a recurring layout, and also happens to contain Manhattan and Dubai. A lot of my dreams there include ongoing travel by subway. Quick question: a lot of what I do in my mall could be described as actions with a clear goal that I can never actually reach. If I spend a dream shopping for food in the countless restaurants and night markets, I’ll never get around to buying anything, or, if I do, I won’t get to eat it. I’ll browse graphic novels in Tower Records and lose my place before I can finish the story, I’ll transfer trains at countless ramshackle subway stations but never reach my destination. It looks like others on this forum have had the experience of needing to pee but never finding a working toilet. I haven’t had that one, but it feels like a similar vibe. is this my own personal quirk, or are others’ Mall World experiences marked by effort and incompletion?
